description: Create a poll draft (1-100 single-choice questions, 2-10 options each). Returns id, token, version and edit_url. Give the edit_url to the person so they can review, verify and publish it in their browser; the draft expires 24 hours after creation. Never say the poll is published.

email_mode.description: One of none (default), optional or required: whether participants are asked for an email address shared with the creator. Cannot change after publishing.

email_purpose.description: Required when email_mode is optional or required: a short note (up to 200 characters) telling participants why the email is collected.

image_url.description: Optional direct HTTPS image URL (up to 2048 characters). The image is loaded by participants' browsers, not by the server.

options.description: 2-10 options; duplicates within a question are rejected

image_url.description: Optional direct HTTPS image URL (up to 2048 characters).

text.description: Option text, 1-100 characters after trimming. Plain text.
Question text, 1-200 characters after trimming. Plain text.

title.description: Optional poll title, up to 200 characters after trimming. Empty means the first question is used as the title.
